meta.description: AWS Lambda serverless functions for event-driven compute. Use when creating functions, configuring triggers, debugging invocations, optimizing cold starts, setting up event source mappings, or managing layers.

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你创建、配置和管理 AWS Lambda 函数，包括设置触发器、调试调用、优化冷启动、管理事件源映射和层。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 AWS 上的无服务器计算任务，例如创建函数、添加 S3 或 SQS 触发器、调试超时或内存错误时。

say.text: 给 MyFunction 添加一个 S3 触发器，桶名 my-bucket。
say.note: Claude 会提供添加权限和配置通知的步骤。

say.text: 我的 Lambda 函数超时了，怎么排查？
say.note: Claude 会给出检查配置、增加超时等调试建议。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you create, configure, and manage AWS Lambda functions, including setting up triggers, debugging invocations, optimizing cold starts, managing event source mappings, and layers.
howto.when_en: When you need to work with serverless compute on AWS, such as creating functions, adding S3 or SQS triggers, debugging timeout or memory errors.

say_en.text: Create a Python 3.12 Lambda function with 256MB memory and 30s timeout.
say_en.note: Claude generates CLI or boto3 code.

say_en.text: Add an S3 trigger to MyFunction for bucket my-bucket.
say_en.note: Claude provides permission and notification steps.

say_en.text: My Lambda function is timing out, how to debug?
